title: Map the Work Before You Automate

beats.narration: Most businesses buy software before they map the work.
beats.headline: TOOLS BEFORE CLARITY
beats.visual: Overwhelmed owner surrounded by disconnected app and task cut-outs.
beats.motion: Slow push-in with paper elements drifting.

beats.narration: Start with what repeats, where it breaks, and who owns the next step.
beats.headline: MAP THE REPEATS
beats.visual: Four-step paper workflow with three broken handoffs highlighted.
beats.motion: Workflow cards enter one at a time.

beats.narration: Automate the smallest dependable step first.
beats.headline: START SMALL
beats.visual: One task passes through an AI assistant and returns to a human reviewer.
beats.motion: Task card moves through the pipeline.

beats.narration: One clear workflow creates the foundation for the next.
beats.headline: BUILD THE NEXT LOOP
beats.visual: A clean Lux operating map expands from one successful workflow.
beats.motion: Network grows from the first completed loop.
